1	using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

3	using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
4	using Polly.RateLimiting;
5	
6	namespace Polly;
7	
8	/// <summary>
9	/// Extensions for adding rate limiting to <see cref="ResiliencePipelineBuilder"/>.
10	/// </summary>
11	public static class RateLimiterResiliencePipelineBuilderExtensions
12	{
13	    /// <summary>
14	    /// Adds the concurrency limiter.
15	    /// </summary>
16	    /// <typeparam name="TBuilder">The builder type.</typeparam>
17	    /// <param name="builder">The builder instance.</param>
18	    /// <param name="permitLimit">Maximum number of permits that can be leased concurrently.</param>
19	    /// <param name="queueLimit">Maximum number of permits that can be queued concurrently.</param>
20	    /// <returns>The builder instance with the concurrency limiter added.</returns>
21	    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="builder"/> is <see langword="null"/>.</exception>
22	    /// <exception cref="ValidationException">Thrown when the options constructed from the arguments are invalid.</exception>
23	    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">Thrown when <paramref name="permitLimit"/> or <paramref name="queueLimit"/> is invalid.</exception>
24	    public static TBuilder AddConcurrencyLimiter<TBuilder>(
25	        this TBuilder builder,
26	        int permitLimit,
27	        int queueLimit = 0)
28	        where TBuilder : ResiliencePipelineBuilderBase
29	    {
30	        return builder.AddConcurrencyLimiter(new ConcurrencyLimiterOptions
31	        {
32	            PermitLimit = permitLimit,
33	            QueueLimit = queueLimit
34	        });
35	    }
36	
37	    /// <summary>
38	    /// Adds the concurrency limiter.
39	    /// </summary>
40	    /// <typeparam name="TBuilder">The builder type.</typeparam>
41	    /// <param name="builder">The builder instance.</param>
42	    /// <param name="options">The concurrency limiter options.</param>
43	    /// <returns>The builder instance with the concurrency limiter added.</returns>
44	    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="builder"/> or <paramref name="options"/> is <see langword="null"/>.</exception>
45	    /// <exception cref="ValidationException">Thrown when the options constructed from the arguments are invalid.</exception>
46	    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">Thrown when <paramref name="options"/> are invalid.</exception>
47	    public static TBuilder AddConcurrencyLimiter<TBuilder>(
48	        this TBuilder builder,
49	        ConcurrencyLimiterOptions options)
50	        where TBuilder : ResiliencePipelineBuilderBase
51	    {
52	        Guard.NotNull(builder);
53	        Guard.NotNull(options);
54	
55	        return builder.AddRateLimiter(new RateLimiterStrategyOptions
56	        {
57	            DefaultRateLimiterOptions = options
58	        });
59	    }
60	
61	    /// <summary>
62	    /// Adds the rate limiter.
63	    /// </summary>
64	    /// <typeparam name="TBuilder">The builder type.</typeparam>
65	    /// <param name="builder">The builder instance.</param>
66	    /// <param name="limiter">The rate limiter to use.</param>
67	    /// <returns>The builder instance with the rate limiter added.</returns>
68	    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="builder"/> or <paramref name="limiter"/> is <see langword="null"/>.</exception>
69	    /// <exception cref="ValidationException">Thrown when the options constructed from the arguments are invalid.</exception>
70	    public static TBuilder AddRateLimiter<TBuilder>(
71	        this TBuilder builder,
72	        RateLimiter limiter)
73	        where TBuilder : ResiliencePipelineBuilderBase
74	    {
75	        Guard.NotNull(builder);
76	        Guard.NotNull(limiter);
77	
78	        return builder.AddRateLimiter(new RateLimiterStrategyOptions
79	        {

Every caller I found is either an overload of the target method itself or a documentation snippet. I searched for the name `AddConcurrencyLimiter` across the repo (read-only). I didn't trace callers of the snippet methods. They are `internal static` docs samples, so there may be none.

**Production methods that reach it**

- `RateLimiterResiliencePipelineBuilderExtensions.AddConcurrencyLimiter` is the only production method in `src/` that calls it. It has two overloads. The `(int permitLimit, int queueLimit = 0)` overload calls the `(ConcurrencyLimiterOptions options)` overload, so the options overload is reached through it.
- Nothing else under `src/Polly.*` calls it. The options overload calls `AddRateLimiter`, but that is downstream of the target, not a caller.

**Doc-snippet callers**

These are in `src/Snippets/Docs`, which is sample code for the documentation and not shipped library code:

- `RateLimiter.Usage` (`RateLimiter.cs`)

The benchmark helpers in `bench/Polly.Core.Benchmarks/Utils/Helper.RateLimiting.cs` and `Helper.MultipleStrategies.cs` also call it. They are not production code, and I didn't name their methods.
